cards.title: Figural Pendant
cards.extract: This emphatically male figure combines a human body with a composite animal head. The antlers are the stag's; the snout, perhaps a snarling feline's; and the hair is formed of braided serpents whose heads hiss from the figure's shoulders. The extended tongue may convey aggression or perhaps death because dying animals are depicted with lolling tongues. Either condition is in keeping with the creature's ferocity.

cards.title: House in Ibiza, The Roca Views / Fran Silvestre Arquitectos
cards.extract: Can we build on this hillside by placing a single element upon it? In response to this question, the project is conceived as a very thin plane, just 15 centimetres thick, which folds along the natural slope of the terrain while simultaneously responding to the constraints of the regulations.
